bioBn:
Nurul Islam Moni is the member of parliament (MP) for Barguna-2 (Pathorghata, Bamna and Betagi) in the 13th Parliament and the Chief Whip of Parliament. A central vice-chairman of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), this experienced parliamentarian has been elected an MP for the fourth time. He was appointed Chief Whip on 2 March 2026. He is currently chair of the House Committee and a member of the Business Advisory Committee, the Special Committee on Amending the Constitution, the Standing Committee on Privileges and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Finance.

He was born in the village of Monipur in Pathorghata upazila, Barguna district. He is the son of Mazhar Uddin and Ambia Khatun. After passing his higher secondary examination under the Jashore Education Board in 1972, he obtained a BSc from the University of Dhaka in 1975 and an MSc with a first class in 1976.

He was first elected MP for Barguna-2 as an independent candidate in the election to the 4th Parliament in 1988. He won again as an independent candidate in the election to the 5th Parliament in 1991, and later joined the BNP. He was elected president of Barguna district BNP. In the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001 he became an MP for the third time, as the BNP candidate. In the 8th Parliament he was chair of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Science and Information and Communication Technology, and also served as a panel speaker.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Barguna-2 for the fourth time with 90,643 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the election he was given the post of Chief Whip of Parliament.
leadBn: Nurul Islam Moni is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Barguna-2 and Vice-Chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party.
